title: 坐着活动脚踝
description: 成人坐稳凳子，抬一脚做小幅脚踝转动。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult sits on a stable bench and extends one lower leg a little so the ankle can turn gently in the air. The other foot stays flat and both hands rest on the seat. Show a small relaxed rotation, not an exaggerated pointed toe or forced stretch. A climbing shoe pair and socks sit neatly beside the bench, while the background contains a softly lit ordinary changing area. Use layered cardboard diorama illustration with folded architectural planes, readable joints, small material shadows, and beige, aqua, and orange accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
